memberships.page_title: Filtered Regular Nilpotent Pencils in Dimension Five

statement: With the quartic kernel fixed at the principal point, the nilpotent-pencil tangent space has dimension 16 and sl2 type V0+V2+V4+V6; fixing the descended cubic kernel leaves only scalar rescaling, so the other 15 directions are exactly relative descended-cubic motion.
